verdict.rationale: SendGrid documents a single POST /v3/mail/send call. Its quickstart gives copy-paste sample code in cURL and the official SDKs, such as the Node `@sendgrid/mail` setApiKey snippet. Community users report reliable, low-latency transactional sending. Missing for 10: no evidence that a message ID is returned for tracking, no listing of the minimal required fields, and no hands-on corroboration of the quickstart flow.
